uniform_note.deck: Charcoal work uniform, issued on your first day aboard.
uniform_note.line: Olive-grey tunic and cap of a commissioned officer.
uniform_note.command: Black tunic and cap, worn by those who command a ship.
uniform_note.flag: White tunic and cap of a flag officer.

ribbon_note.ribbon_good_conduct: Steady service through the first weeks aboard.
ribbon_note.ribbon_meritorious: Months of reliable work for the fleet.
ribbon_note.ribbon_distinguished: Long service with a record to show for it.
ribbon_note.ribbon_fleet_cross: The fleet's highest commendation, for a career aboard.

rule.chat_turn: Finish a chat turn with the assistant.
rule.voice_turn: Finish a voice turn with the assistant.
rule.quest_posted: Post a quest for the crew.
rule.quest_completed: A quest you posted is completed.
rule.agent_hired: Enlist a new officer (once per officer).
rule.daily_visit: Report aboard the Verse, once a day.
rule.deck_discovered: Visit a deck for the first time.
rule.simulator_round: Play a scored round in the simulator room.
rule.simulator_record: Set a new best in the simulator room.
rule.team_briefing: Hold a team briefing in the briefing room.
rule.inspection: Walk every room of a deck, once per deck a day.
rule.task_blocked: Report a task as blocked, with the reason.
rule.jarvis_answered: Answer you, in chat or by voice.
rule.delegated: Hand a task to an officer.
rule.walk_together: Walk with you around the ship.

record.title: Service record
record.top_rank: You hold the highest rank in the fleet.
record.log_empty: No entries yet. Talk to the assistant or give the crew work.
record.uniforms_hint: The quartermaster issues each tier's uniform when you reach its first rank. Wear any you have been issued.
record.ribbons_hint: Commendations for long, steady service. Officers earn them too.
record.earn_hint: Every award is checked against the ship's own ledger: the same thing never pays twice.

salute.deck: The deck crew stands a little straighter today.
salute.line: A commission is yours. The crew salutes you.
salute.command: The ship answers to you now.
salute.flag: The fleet takes its course from you.

promo.salute_drone: Your companion drone logs the promotion and keeps to your heel.
